AI-Copyright-Skill 2.0.0

- Major update introducing AI-native patent and copyright generation for AI project materials.
- Supports direct generation of Word (.docx) and PowerPoint (.pptx) deliverables.
- Covers 7 core AI domains and 22 sub-directions with 11 specialized patent claim templates.
- Adds automated project analysis (including code/paper review, industry/category detection) and patentability self-check.
- Now includes prior-art search, desensitization, claim/scheme drafting, and iterative correction workflows.
- Enhanced risk assessment and domain-specific countermeasure guidance for high-risk AI patent areas.
